topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: This town's got secrets under every cobblestone, but a time capsule? Now that's a new one. I got a call, anonymous of course, about a typewritten letter in a rusty tin box. The guy, or gal, claiming to have found it couldn’t remember hiding it. Figured the usual—drinks, a bad night, or a borrowed life. But this? This reeks of something twisted. The kind of story that ends in the cold, wet pages of the morning news. I'm heading out, raincoat slick and nerves colder, to dig up what they forgot. Time capsules don’t bury themselves, and neither do the lies.
